title: String Reversal
spec: Implement a function `reverseString(string $str)` that takes a string and returns its reversed version. For example, `reverseString('hello')` should return `'olleh'`, and `reverseString('PHP')` should return `'PHP'`.

title: Sum of Array Elements
spec: Write a function `sumArray(array $numbers)` that calculates the sum of all integer elements in an array. For instance, `sumArray([1, 2, 3])` should return `6`, and `sumArray([])` should return `0`.

title: Factorial Calculation
spec: Create a function `calculateFactorial(int $n)` that computes the factorial of a non-negative integer. `calculateFactorial(5)` should return `120`, and `calculateFactorial(0)` should return `1`.

title: Check Palindrome
spec: Develop a function `isPalindrome(string $text)` that determines if a given string is a palindrome (reads the same forwards and backwards, ignoring case). `isPalindrome('Racecar')` should return `true`, and `isPalindrome('hello')` should return `false`.

title: Count Vowels
spec: Implement a function `countVowels(string $text)` that counts the number of vowels (a, e, i, o, u, case-insensitive) in a string. `countVowels('Programming')` should return `3`, and `countVowels('Rhythm')` should return `0`.

title: Fibonacci Sequence
spec: Write a function `generateFibonacci(int $n)` that returns an array containing the first `n` Fibonacci numbers. `generateFibonacci(5)` should return `[0, 1, 1, 2, 3]`, and `generateFibonacci(1)` should return `[0]`.

title: Find Max in Array
spec: Create a function `findMax(array $numbers)` that finds the largest number in an array of integers. `findMax([10, 5, 20, 8])` should return `20`, and `findMax([-1, -5, -2])` should return `-1`.

title: Celsius to Fahrenheit
spec: Develop a function `celsiusToFahrenheit(float $celsius)` that converts temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit. `celsiusToFahrenheit(0)` should return `32.0`, and `celsiusToFahrenheit(100)` should return `212.0`.

title: Calculate Average
spec: Implement a function `calculateAverage(array $numbers)` that computes the average of numbers in an array. `calculateAverage([1, 2, 3, 4, 5])` should return `3.0`, and `calculateAverage([])` should return `0.0`.

title: Array Element Count
spec: Write a function `countOccurrences(array $arr, mixed $value)` that counts how many times a specific value appears in an array. `countOccurrences([1, 2, 2, 3, 2], 2)` should return `3`, and `countOccurrences(['a', 'b', 'c'], 'd')` should return `0`.

title: Remove Duplicates
spec: Create a function `removeDuplicates(array $arr)` that returns a new array with all duplicate elements removed, preserving order. `removeDuplicates([1, 2, 2, 3, 1])` should return `[1, 2, 3]`, and `removeDuplicates(['a', 'b', 'a'])` should return `['a', 'b']`.

title: Merge Associative Arrays
spec: Develop a function `mergeArrays(array $arr1, array $arr2)` that merges two associative arrays, with values from the second array overwriting those from the first if keys overlap. `mergeArrays(['a' => 1, 'b' => 2], ['b' => 3, 'c' => 4])` should return `['a' => 1, 'b' => 3, 'c' => 4]`, and `mergeArrays([], ['x' => 5])` should return `['x' => 5]`.

title: String Truncation
spec: Implement a function `truncateString(string $text, int $maxLength)` that truncates a string to a specified maximum length, appending '...' if truncated. `truncateString('Hello world', 8)` should return `'Hello...'`, and `truncateString('Short', 10)` should return `'Short'`.

title: Validate Email Format
spec: Write a function `isValidEmail(string $email)` that checks if a string is a valid email address using a simple regex pattern. `isValidEmail('test@example.com')` should return `true`, and `isValidEmail('invalid-email')` should return `false`.

title: Simple Calculator
spec: Create a function `simpleCalculator(float $num1, float $num2, string $operator)` that performs basic arithmetic operations (+, -, *, /). `simpleCalculator(10, 5, '+')` should return `15.0`, and `simpleCalculator(10, 2, '/')` should return `5.0`.

title: Generate Random Password
spec: Develop a function `generatePassword(int $length)` that generates a random string of alphanumeric characters of a given length. `strlen(generatePassword(10))` should return `10`, and `strlen(generatePassword(0))` should return `0`.

title: Current Date and Time
spec: Implement a function `getCurrentDateTime()` that returns the current date and time in 'Y-m-d H:i:s' format. The output should be a string like `'2023-10-27 10:30:00'` (actual time will vary). Test with `is_string(getCurrentDateTime())` returning `true` and `strlen(getCurrentDateTime())` returning `19`.

title: Days Between Dates
spec: Write a function `daysBetweenDates(string $date1, string $date2)` that calculates the number of days between two dates (format 'YYYY-MM-DD'). `daysBetweenDates('2023-01-01', '2023-01-05')` should return `4`, and `daysBetweenDates('2023-01-05', '2023-01-01')` should return `4`.

title: Format Currency
spec: Create a function `formatCurrency(float $amount, string $currencySymbol = '$')` that formats a number as currency with two decimal places. `formatCurrency(1234.567)` should return `'$1234.57'`, and `formatCurrency(99.9, '€')` should return `'€99.90'`.

title: Area of a Rectangle
spec: Develop a function `calculateRectangleArea(float $width, float $height)` that computes the area of a rectangle. `calculateRectangleArea(5, 10)` should return `50.0`, and `calculateRectangleArea(2.5, 4)` should return `10.0`.

title: Check Even or Odd
spec: Implement a function `isEven(int $number)` that returns `true` if a number is even, `false` otherwise. `isEven(4)` should return `true`, and `isEven(7)` should return `false`.

title: First N Characters
spec: Write a function `getFirstNChars(string $text, int $n)` that returns the first `n` characters of a string. `getFirstNChars('Programming', 5)` should return `'Progr'`, and `getFirstNChars('Hello', 10)` should return `'Hello'`.

title: URL Slug Generator
spec: Create a function `generateSlug(string $title)` that converts a string into a URL-friendly slug (lowercase, hyphens instead of spaces, remove special chars). `generateSlug('My Awesome Post Title!')` should return `'my-awesome-post-title'`, and `generateSlug('Another Title with Numbers 123')` should return `'another-title-with-numbers-123'`.

title: Simple Array Filter
spec: Develop a function `filterGreaterThan(array $numbers, int $threshold)` that returns a new array containing only numbers greater than a given threshold. `filterGreaterThan([10, 5, 20, 8], 10)` should return `[20]`, and `filterGreaterThan([1, 2, 3], 5)` should return `[]`.

title: Word Count
spec: Implement a function `countWords(string $text)` that counts the number of words in a string. Assume words are separated by spaces. `countWords('Hello world from PHP')` should return `4`, and `countWords('OneWord')` should return `1`.

title: Temperature Conversion: F to C
spec: Write a function `fahrenheitToCelsius(float $fahrenheit)` that converts temperature from Fahrenheit to Celsius. `fahrenheitToCelsius(32)` should return `0.0`, and `fahrenheitToCelsius(212)` should return `100.0`.

title: String Starts With
spec: Create a function `startsWith(string $haystack, string $needle)` that checks if a string starts with another string. `startsWith('hello world', 'hello')` should return `true`, and `startsWith('PHP is fun', 'java')` should return `false`.

title: Calculate Discount
spec: Develop a function `calculateDiscount(float $price, float $discountPercentage)` that calculates the discounted price. `calculateDiscount(100, 10)` should return `90.0`, and `calculateDiscount(50, 0)` should return `50.0`.

title: Get Array Keys
spec: Implement a function `getArrayKeys(array $arr)` that returns an array of all keys from an associative array. `getArrayKeys(['a' => 1, 'b' => 2])` should return `['a', 'b']`, and `getArrayKeys([])` should return `[]`.

title: Rock Paper Scissors
spec: Write a function `playRPS(string $player1Choice, string $player2Choice)` that simulates a single round of Rock Paper Scissors. Return 'Player 1 Wins', 'Player 2 Wins', or 'Draw'. `playRPS('rock', 'scissors')` should return `'Player 1 Wins'`, and `playRPS('paper', 'rock')` should return `'Player 1 Wins'`.

title: Simple User Object
spec: Create a class `User` with a constructor `__construct(string $name, string $email)` and a method `getInfo()` that returns a string 'Name: [name], Email: [email]'. `(new User('Alice', 'alice@example.com'))->getInfo()` should return `'Name: Alice, Email: alice@example.com'`. `(new User('Bob', 'bob@test.com'))->getInfo()` should return `'Name: Bob, Email: bob@test.com'`.

title: Unique Random Numbers
spec: Develop a function `generateUniqueRandomNumbers(int $count, int $min, int $max)` that generates an array of `count` unique random numbers within the specified range. Assume `$count` is less than or equal to `($max - $min + 1)`. `count(generateUniqueRandomNumbers(3, 1, 5))` should return `3`. The elements of `generateUniqueRandomNumbers(2, 1, 2)` should be `[1, 2]` or `[2, 1]`.

title: Parse CSV Line
spec: Implement a function `parseCsvLine(string $line, string $delimiter = ',')` that parses a single CSV line into an array of strings. `parseCsvLine('apple,banana,orange')` should return `['apple', 'banana', 'orange']`, and `parseCsvLine('one;two;three', ';')` should return `['one', 'two', 'three']`.

title: Calculate Age
spec: Write a function `calculateAge(string $birthdate)` that calculates a person's age given their birthdate in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. The age should be an integer. Assume the current date for calculation. If today is '2023-10-27', `calculateAge('1990-10-27')` should return `33`, and `calculateAge('1990-11-01')` should return `32`.

title: Simple Inventory Update
spec: Create a function `updateInventory(array $inventory, string $item, int $quantity)` that updates the quantity of an item in an associative array inventory. If the item doesn't exist, add it. `updateInventory(['apple' => 10], 'apple', 5)` should return `['apple' => 15]`, and `updateInventory(['banana' => 20], 'orange', 3)` should return `['banana' => 20, 'orange' => 3]`.

title: String Contains
spec: Develop a function `stringContains(string $haystack, string $needle)` that checks if a string contains another string (case-sensitive). `stringContains('hello world', 'world')` should return `true`, and `stringContains('PHP rocks', 'java')` should return `false`.

title: Convert to Uppercase
spec: Implement a function `toUppercase(string $text)` that converts a string to all uppercase characters. `toUppercase('Hello World')` should return `'HELLO WORLD'`, and `toUppercase('php')` should return `'PHP'`.

title: Calculate Circle Area
spec: Write a function `calculateCircleArea(float $radius)` that computes the area of a circle. Use `M_PI` for Pi. `calculateCircleArea(1)` should return `3.1415926535898` (approx), and `calculateCircleArea(2)` should return `12.566370614359` (approx).

title: Array Intersection
spec: Create a function `arrayIntersection(array $arr1, array $arr2)` that returns an array containing elements common to both input arrays. `arrayIntersection([1, 2, 3], [2, 3, 4])` should return `[2, 3]`, and `arrayIntersection(['a', 'b'], ['c', 'd'])` should return `[]`.

title: Simple Login Check
spec: Develop a function `checkLogin(string $username, string $password)` that checks if provided credentials match a hardcoded username 'admin' and password 'password123'. `checkLogin('admin', 'password123')` should return `true`, and `checkLogin('guest', '123')` should return `false`.

title: Remove Empty Array Elements
spec: Implement a function `removeEmptyElements(array $arr)` that removes all empty string or null elements from an array. `removeEmptyElements(['a', '', 'b', null, 'c'])` should return `['a', 'b', 'c']`, and `removeEmptyElements([1, 0, ''])` should return `[1, 0]`.

title: Get File Extension
spec: Write a function `getFileExtension(string $filename)` that extracts the file extension from a filename. `getFileExtension('document.pdf')` should return `'pdf'`, and `getFileExtension('archive.tar.gz')` should return `'gz'`.

title: Last N Characters
spec: Create a function `getLastNChars(string $text, int $n)` that returns the last `n` characters of a string. `getLastNChars('Programming', 5)` should return `'mming'`, and `getLastNChars('Hello', 10)` should return `'Hello'`.

title: Random Array Element
spec: Develop a function `getRandomElement(array $arr)` that returns a random element from an array. `in_array(getRandomElement(['a', 'b', 'c']), ['a', 'b', 'c'])` should return `true`. Calling `getRandomElement([])` should return `null`.

title: Basic Grade Calculator
spec: Implement a function `calculateGrade(int $score)` that returns a letter grade (A, B, C, D, F) based on a score (A: 90+, B: 80-89, C: 70-79, D: 60-69, F: <60). `calculateGrade(95)` should return `'A'`, and `calculateGrade(65)` should return `'D'`.

title: Simple HTTP GET Request (Mock)
spec: Write a function `mockHttpGet(string $url)` that simulates a basic HTTP GET request. It should return a string like 'Data from [url]' for any input URL. `mockHttpGet('https://api.example.com/data')` should return `'Data from https://api.example.com/data'`, and `mockHttpGet('http://localhost')` should return `'Data from http://localhost'`.

title: Convert Array to String
spec: Create a function `arrayToString(array $arr, string $separator = ', ')` that joins array elements into a string using a specified separator. `arrayToString(['apple', 'banana', 'orange'])` should return `'apple, banana, orange'`, and `arrayToString(['one', 'two'], '-')` should return `'one-two'`.

title: Basic Queue Simulation
spec: Develop a class `SimpleQueue` with methods `enqueue(mixed $item)` and `dequeue()`. `dequeue()` should remove and return the oldest item, or `null` if empty. `$q = new SimpleQueue(); $q->enqueue('A'); $q->enqueue('B'); $q->dequeue()` should return `'A'`. `$q->dequeue()` should return `'B'`.

title: String Replace All
spec: Implement a function `replaceAll(string $haystack, string $needle, string $replacement)` that replaces all occurrences of a substring within a string. `replaceAll('hello world hello', 'hello', 'hi')` should return `'hi world hi'`, and `replaceAll('PHP is great', 'Java', 'Python')` should return `'PHP is great'`.

title: Check Leap Year
spec: Write a function `isLeapYear(int $year)` that determines if a given year is a leap year. `isLeapYear(2000)` should return `true`, and `isLeapYear(2023)` should return `false`.

title: Extract Numbers from String
spec: Create a function `extractNumbers(string $text)` that extracts all digits from a string and returns them as a single string. `extractNumbers('Price: $12.99')` should return `'1299'`, and `extractNumbers('No numbers here')` should return `''`.

title: Calculate BMI
spec: Develop a function `calculateBMI(float $weightKg, float $heightM)` that calculates Body Mass Index. `calculateBMI(70, 1.75)` should return `22.857142857143` (approx), and `calculateBMI(50, 1.6)` should return `19.53125` (approx).

title: Reverse Words in String
spec: Implement a function `reverseWords(string $text)` that reverses the order of words in a sentence. `reverseWords('Hello world PHP')` should return `'PHP world Hello'`, and `reverseWords('OneWord')` should return `'OneWord'`.

title: Generate HTML List
spec:
Write a function `generateHtmlList(array $items)` that creates an unordered HTML list (`
  • ...
`) from an array of strings. `generateHtmlList(['Item 1', 'Item 2'])` should return `'
  • Item 1
  • Item 2
'`, and `generateHtmlList([])` should return `''`.

title: Find Smallest in Array
spec: Create a function `findSmallest(array $numbers)` that finds the smallest number in an array of integers. `findSmallest([10, 5, 20, 8])` should return `5`, and `findSmallest([-1, -5, -2])` should return `-5`.

title: Convert Seconds to HH:MM:SS
spec: Develop a function `secondsToHMS(int $seconds)` that converts a total number of seconds into 'HH:MM:SS' format. `secondsToHMS(3665)` should return `'01:01:05'`, and `secondsToHMS(60)` should return `'00:01:00'`.

title: Validate Credit Card Number (Luhn Algorithm - simplified)
spec: Implement a function `isValidLuhn(string $cardNumber)` that performs a simplified check on a credit card number using the Luhn algorithm (sum of digits is divisible by 10). For simplicity, assume the card number is a string of digits only. `isValidLuhn('49927398716')` should return `true`, and `isValidLuhn('49927398717')` should return `false`.

title: Calculate Distance (2D Points)
spec: Write a function `calculateDistance(array $point1, array $point2)` that calculates the Euclidean distance between two 2D points (each represented as `['x' => float, 'y' => float]`). `calculateDistance(['x' => 0, 'y' => 0], ['x' => 3, 'y' => 4])` should return `5.0`, and `calculateDistance(['x' => 1, 'y' => 1], ['x' => 1, 'y' => 1])` should return `0.0`.

title: Simple Todo List
spec: Create a class `TodoList` with methods `addTask(string $task)` and `getTasks()`. `getTasks()` should return an array of tasks. `$todo = new TodoList(); $todo->addTask('Buy milk'); $todo->addTask('Walk dog'); $todo->getTasks()` should return `['Buy milk', 'Walk dog']`. `$todo2 = new TodoList(); $todo2->getTasks()` should return `[]`.

title: Count Character Occurrences
spec: Develop a function `countChar(string $text, string $char)` that counts how many times a specific character appears in a string (case-sensitive). `countChar('programming', 'g')` should return `2`, and `countChar('Apple', 'p')` should return `2`.
